Step 7 restart (not dispatch) of stopped lanes, step 10 same-round answers and same-session handoff lines, step 9 docs-only overlap exception — #2515. Step 7 sorts open Issues and hands ownerless ones (no claim or a dead session's expired claim) to idle lanes (cause 8, #2515). Bottleneck rules (#2612): read the screen before a restart (no line to a lane with a wake, an answer to `LANE-BLOCKED`, no repeated restart), `UNREACHABLE` lanes, found = answered on every return, finish ready work before a user question (method: decision D5), decisions to comment and screen, one handoff line per claim id confirmed by `owner`, the open-PR limit N from decision D7 and operating numbers changed together. Report figures name their command; an empty output is not zero (#2678). The judge reads the tables of both refs and an empty check list holds the merge (#2693 audit B1, N1).

Written for rc.2 A1 #2160 from docs/design-review/autonomy-modes-spec.md (DR-02 #2138); no design-22 template exists for modes. Refers to the SPEC by section instead of restating it. Step 5 names the journal lock-busy retry rule (unavailable, bounded caller-side backoff under a cap) — #2345. Step 7 retains the pr_ready handoff skip rule — #2344. Step 8 (merge train, not_run for conflicting PRs, self-check, WIP cap) and step 10 (default loop: end condition, order, no waiting in place, resume after handoff — user decision in #2390) added by #2388; step 7's stop defers to step 10. Short waits, lean change reports, and outward effects as separate commands added by #2401. Entry spelling `--mode-agent` only, legacy alias removed (user decision 2026-11-10, #2286). Label rules added by #2434. Steps 8, 9, 12 and 13: lanes open their own pull requests below four non-draft ones and settle a simultaneous opening by the four lowest numbers (others become drafts), the U6 integration gate (no tip chasing), the one-line round, and the waiting-branch suffix — #2515. Steps 12 keep-going and 14 wake added, report/pr-gate/heavy-checks/claim/goal-lines/self-pick changed so a round never stops on LANE-DONE, a full open-PR count, a wait or a leader request (#2515 comment 6823975793). Step 3 four-way Issue counts and step 13 LANE-BLOCKED for expired foreign claims (cause 8, #2515 comment 6824158448). Step 13 end condition matches keep-going (audit 6824297146 N1). Worktree sessions without the project settings file run no project hook, so claim-verify is the only boundary there (#2581). Orca session-control section, identical in both mode workflows (#2516, leader decision B 6823474405). Bottleneck rules (#2612): renewal by editing the own claim comment, every earlier claim id in a handoff request, a fresh branch for an unread trailer, the open-PR limit N from decision D7 with cross-lane `pr-wait` order, pre-push checks, a slot wait is no wake reason, a lost reservation posts no verdict, no-op wake backoff and no reprint of unchanged lines, the poll interval only for unchanged state. Decided values (#2612, #1975 comment 6840449133): same-session renewal without a handoff line (D1), lane timeout takeover by=timeout under three conditions (D2), written user questions (D5), fallback wake up to 1,800 seconds (D6), open-PR limit eight (D7). No author ci: line (D4, #2612, #1975 comment 6840449133): the auditor cites the head's CI run in the verdict and the merge gate reads the head's check runs. Standing goal (#2679): the state step reads moai-cli goal-show (one file per clone, read from every worktree); an active goal's end condition and exclusions hold after a restart without the person repeating it; lanes only read it. Usage-limit rule added by #2668 S3 (lane renews its claims before a claude.ai usage limit; the leader treats a usage_limit lane as held, not stopped). Codex hook trust (#2592): claim-verify names the primary checkout's trust_level and the /hooks review, the measured worktree inheritance of project trust, and that a lane never bypasses hook trust. LANE-BLOCKED kind/owner/next fields and the resume point's who-clears-it (#2769, #2554 leader decision 6861024531). The self-pick and wake steps name `moai lane-next` (fresh GitHub read each time, reversible decisions go on with the safe default) — #2831; at the open-PR limit the pr-gate step opens a draft instead of waiting (leader decision 6870150891).
